## Source: amazon-inspector (df355a2f1d1cc0d420f953cf7f89aefb0ff9a6ae0c366552fbb8e94e319b151a)
Analysis of asrdock 0.1.0 on PyPI produced no indicators of installer-side harm. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or filesystem secret reads, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, no silent relay, no backdoor, and no destructive behavior were observed in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (f6bd33cecc5263c6ff8d666d61c33ddbe5b487331c1f2edd13873c1eef145b5c)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
